label: AdGuard Home
description: DNS ad blocking: stats, filters, clients
agentGuide: Base path /control. Status: GET /control/status; numbers: GET /control/stats (num_dns_queries, num_blocked_filtering, top_queried_domains, top_blocked_domains, top_clients); query log: GET /control/querylog?limit=50&search=<domain>. Protection: POST /control/protection {"enabled": false, "duration": 300000} pauses it (ms). Filters: GET /control/filtering/status; custom rules: POST /control/filtering/set_rules {"rules": ["||ads.example.com^"]} replaces them all — read first; refresh: POST /control/filtering/refresh {"whitelist": false}. Clients: GET /control/clients; DNS rewrites: GET /control/rewrite/list, POST /control/rewrite/add {"domain": "...", "answer": "..."}.
